mitigations.threat_name: Telemetry spoofing and jamming on downlink
mitigations.title: RF frame authentication and sequencing

mitigations.threat_name: Telemetry spoofing and jamming on downlink
mitigations.title: Adaptive anti-jam waveform selection
mitigations.description: Implement frequency hopping and spread-spectrum techniques with automatic fallback under detected jamming.

mitigations.threat_name: Telemetry spoofing and jamming on downlink
mitigations.title: Downlink monitoring and anomaly response policy
mitigations.description: Define operator procedures for telemetry loss or anomaly detection including alternate comms activation.

mitigations.threat_name: Command spoofing and replay on uplink
mitigations.title: Challenge-response command authentication
mitigations.description: Require fresh nonces and signed challenges for every uplink command set.

mitigations.threat_name: Command spoofing and replay on uplink
mitigations.title: Replay protection via timestamp windows
mitigations.description: Enforce strict time-bounded validity for all command tokens and nonces.

mitigations.threat_name: Command spoofing and replay on uplink
mitigations.title: Uplink command authorization policy

mitigations.title: TLS mutual authentication and certificate pinning

mitigations.title: Sensor data source validation policy

mitigations.title: Signed tasking packages with hash chaining

mitigations.title: Tasking approval and dual-control policy

mitigations.title: Maintenance port access control policy

mitigations.title: Signed and timestamped HUMS records

mitigations.title: HUMS integrity audit policy

mitigations.title: Hardware-enforced load signing verification

mitigations.title: Software load authorization and chain-of-custody policy

mitigations.title: LAN segment isolation and integrity gateway

mitigations.title: Package distribution change control policy

mitigations.title: Key rotation and escrow policy

mitigations.title: Intelligence source vetting policy

mitigations.title: Weapon release authorization policy

mitigations.title: Status message signing and sequence validation

mitigations.title: Threshold-signed weapon packages

mitigations.title: Weapon package release board policy

mitigations.title: Feed source certificate pinning

mitigations.title: Intel source accreditation policy

mitigations.title: Plan integrity gateway at broker

mitigations.title: Plan change approval policy

mitigations.title: HSM-protected key transport

mitigations.title: Intel source accreditation and monitoring policy

mitigations.title: Intel feed accreditation policy
